The heron has held the last ferry for years, pressed in the middle of a wade. The
Warden froze the sluices. Even the water has been waiting to finish its journey.
The Scribe once lived beside this marsh. The Ferrykeeper remembers a house, a
flood, and the moment the rain stopped moving. The river was their first page.
Only a torn edge remains. The rest has not returned to the Album.
